verdict.rationale: Databricks Marketplace lets customers discover, evaluate, and connect directly from their workspace to third-party listings including datasets, AI models, notebooks, apps, and MCP servers, effectively enriching analysts' own data in-platform; an Open Marketplace variant even works without a workspace. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of analysts actually enriching datasets via Marketplace and details on data-join/enrichment workflow specifics beyond discovery/connection.
